title: Idaltuh qammalsime wayta maaqo
intro: Yallih Qari diini aracal, Yallih idaltuh yan taama abeexiga inkih tan qammalsimak sugteh tan kaxxa cuumittet radde. Tama numtin amoh giclo, mango liggiditteh ginoh xaleenah sugeh yan, Divine waado sinni racmatta wagsiisak, qaadik tan caagiidat sumaaqite. hayyeyyeeno farmoytit manok ta habbalte uddur reebisaanam kinni.
clues: Yi ummatta Israa-eel axcuk tamixxige, dumaahi kaxxa abbobtih samad.
Anu inni baritte salaatal tatruse, yi Rabbih foocal sujuudah qibaadah aracal.
Anu idaltuh baxa geeh, Yalla faylisaanam soolise wee acwa.
Yi gibbati yi hanaawih gubat yan qunxa roocih yanbulle rizqih geyto edde anuk.
Anu Zakariyya deqsita nabiyyih sugeeh, Bayt al-Maqdis addal Maryam dacrisaanamih taama yoh teceeh.
gacsi kak yanim yalli maryem oggoleh rizqini teetih elle xayyoose aayat kinni.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Maryam qibaadah aracal dacrisak suge nabiyyi
identity.answer: Maryam qibaadah aracal dacrisak suge nabiyyi

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
